The '''Waskiro system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Waskiro/Legends|Waskiro]].
